data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH says the direct debit for your November 2025 membership fee was returned by your bank. They ask you to pay €47.40 (€39.90 plus a €7.50 reminder fee) by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your gym says the November 2025 membership fee could not be collected because your bank returned the direct debit. You now owe the open fee of €39.90 plus a €7.50 reminder fee (Mahngebühr), €47.40 in total. Pay it by 12 December 2025 to the account shown. If you have already paid, you can ignore the letter. Check that your account has enough money for future debits. If you think the fee is wrong, contact the gym.
